name: secure-remote-workspace
description: Zero-Trust Remote Workspace, Audited SSH & UltraViewer System
author: Zero-Trust Engineering Team

scripts.build: node scripts/ensure-electron.js && npm run build:vite && npm run build:electron && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('server/db/schema.sql', 'dist-electron/server/db/schema.sql')"
scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-node.js && concurrently -k "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:vite"
scripts.electron:dev: node scripts/ensure-electron.js && npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "npm run dev:vite" "electron ."
scripts.electron:server: node scripts/ensure-electron.js && npm run build:electron && electron . --server
scripts.electron:client: node scripts/ensure-electron.js && npm run build:electron && electron . --client
scripts.package:server:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.server.json --win portable zip
scripts.package:server:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.server.json --linux AppImage deb
scripts.package:client:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.client.json --win portable zip
scripts.package:client:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.client.json --linux AppImage deb
scripts.package:all:editions: npm run package:server:win && npm run package:server:linux && npm run package:client:win && npm run package:client:linux
scripts.package:win: npm run package:server:win && npm run package:client:win
scripts.package:linux: npm run package:server:linux && npm run package:client:linux
scripts.test: node scripts/ensure-node.js && npx tsx test_phase2.ts && npx tsx test_phase3.ts && npx tsx test_phase4.ts && npx tsx test_phase5.ts && npx tsx test_phase6.ts && npx tsx test_phase8.ts && npx tsx test_phase9.ts && npx tsx test_phase10.ts && npx tsx test_phase11.ts && npx tsx test_phase12.ts && npx tsx test_phase13.ts && npx tsx test_phase14.ts && npx tsx test_phase17.ts
